title: Zipping the Thought: When and How Compressed Reasoning Data Works in LLM Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2605.28008v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can now solve complex problems through long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, but the trade-off between performance and token cost remains a central challenge. To address this issue, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) often uses compressed reasoning data, where CoT traces are shortened into compact forms. However, the effect of such compressed reasoning data on post-training remains poorly understood. In this paper, we propose a taxonomy of CoT consisting of Explicit CoT, which outputs all operations without aggregation, Composed CoT, which combines multiple operations into a single step, and Implicit CoT, which omits intermediate operations. As a controlled mechanistic study, we construct a synthetic compositional reasoning task that allows controlled variation of difficulty, compression granularity, and data size, and conducted a comprehensive set of experiments across different model families and sizes. Nota

translated_title: 压缩思维：压缩推理数据在LLM后训练中何时以及如何发挥作用
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）现在可以通过长思维链（CoT）推理解决复杂问题，但性能与token成本之间的权衡仍然是一个核心挑战。为了解决这个问题，监督微调（SFT）通常使用压缩的推理数据，即将CoT轨迹缩短为紧凑形式。然而，这种压缩推理数据对后训练的影响仍然知之甚少。在本文中，我们提出了一种CoT分类法，包括显式CoT（输出所有操作而不进行聚合）、组合CoT（将多个操作合并为单一步骤）和隐式CoT（省略中间操作）。作为一项受控的机制研究，我们构建了一个合成的组合推理任务，允许对难度、压缩粒度和数据规模进行可控变化，并在不同模型家族和规模上进行了全面的实验。
tldr: 本文提出了一种将思维链推理分为显式、组合和隐式三种形式的分类法，并通过可控的合成组合推理任务系统性地揭示了压缩推理数据在LLM后训练中何时以及如何发挥作用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a taxonomy of chain-of-thought reasoning (Explicit, Composed, and Implicit CoT) and conducts a controlled mechanistic study on synthetic compositional reasoning tasks to reveal when and how compressed reasoning data works in LLM post-training.
